zh: 我今天下午五点才给你回电话。
old_en: I called you back at five this afternoon.
new_en: I will call you back at five this afternoon.

zh: 你可以晚一点回电话吗？
new_en: Can you call back a little later?

zh: 你能不能等我晚上再回电话？
old_en: Can you wait until I call back in the evening?
new_en: Can you wait for me to call back tonight?

zh: 我回电话时发现你已经挂断了。
old_en: When I called back, I found out you had already hung up.
new_en: When I called back, you had already hung up.
